1.title: Why AI Hacking Makes Code Testing Obsolete | &Truth
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Formal verification and automated reasoning for proving software correctness; &Truth's $70M launch, work on securing C libraries (Linux, OpenSSL), and the case for mathematical proofs over testing in an AI-accelerated threat environment.

1.title: One Founder Now Runs a Game Studio With 20 AI Bots | Walden Yan
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Cognition's Walden Yan walks through Devin Bots — autonomous agents managing parallel work streams with decision-making loops — and argues code review disappears as engineers shift to managing multi-agent teams and setting architectural guardrails rather than reviewing code.

2.title: AI Is Still Far From Autonomous Research | Andrew Gordon Wilson
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Andrew Gordon Wilson (Perplexity Frontier Research lead, NYU) on why current AI systems fall short of autonomous research: covers model orchestration, training with "scientific taste" using simulated environments like Discover Physics, infrastructure scale (10,000 GPUs), and timelines for autonomous AI researchers.

1.title: How To Build The Future: Eric Glyman, Co-CEO of Ramp
1.author: Y Combinator
1.hook: Ramp's CEO discusses the business model that enabled out-investing competitors, their transition to AI agents for financial operations, building internal AI infrastructure ("company brain"), and organizational changes during AI transformation — including a hiring pause and new skill requirements.
